title: Masteri Nam An Khanh
note: A 24.2-hectare development of villas, terraced houses and shophouses west of Hanoi, at Nam An Khanh in Hoai Duc, laid out around planted ground and a retention lake. Aluminium for the scheme is 6063-T6, drawn at the group's own plant so that alloy and finish are consistent across the whole development rather than matched between suppliers.
